name: guard-rules
description: Tool-call guard rules (parser-based). On by default: blocks malformed bash and find rooted at /. Opt-in: Monitor, find without -xdev, pgrep pitfalls, until-grep loops, sudo, run0 confirmation

malformed_bash.title: Block malformed bash
malformed_bash.description: Deny Bash commands that fail to parse. Other Bash rules rely on the parse, so disabling this weakens them.

monitor_disabled.title: Block Monitor tool
monitor_disabled.description: Deny the Monitor tool and point to background Bash.

find_root.title: Block find rooted at /
find_root.description: Deny find commands whose starting point is the filesystem root.

find_xdev.title: Require find -xdev
find_xdev.description: Deny find commands that do not stay on one filesystem (-xdev / -mount).

pgrep_f.title: Require pgrep -a with -f
pgrep_f.description: Deny pgrep -f unless it is pgrep -af.

pgrep_captured.title: Block captured pgrep output
pgrep_captured.description: Deny pgrep output captured in a pipe or substitution.

until_grep.title: Block until-grep loops
until_grep.description: Deny "until grep ..." loops that never exit if the writer dies.

sudo.title: Block sudo
sudo.description: Deny sudo and wrapped sudo; use run0 instead.

run0_confirm.title: Confirm run0
run0_confirm.description: Ask the user, showing the wrapped command, before any run0 invocation.
